claims.disproof_condition: Marvell 後續 10-K／10-Q 停止揭露 LPO chipsets 或 CPO 產品線，或將其移出 interconnect 產品組合而無替代表述。核查頻率：每年 10-K 與每季 10-Q。
claims.statement: Marvell FY2026 10-K Item 1 一手逐字列出其 interconnect 產品組合，同時涵蓋 CPO、LPO chipsets 與 TIA／laser driver——三者在本圖中原本分屬不同狀態：tech:cpo 已有 4 個供應商、tech:tia_driver 已有邊、而 tech:lpo 在此之前是**完全孤立的節點（0 條邊）**。LPO chipsets 由 optimized TIAs 與 laser drivers 組成，定位於 AI 資料中心內 predictable and controlled channel 的短距 compute fabric 連接，公司自述其提供高於銅纜的頻寬與距離。⚠ 邊界：(1) 本文件為產品線描述，**未揭露任一產品線的營收、占比、客戶或市占**，不得據此推論商業成熟度；(2) 三條邊的 substitutability／sole_source／qualification_status 皆刻意留空——10-K 沒有任何關於替代難度或獨家性的陳述，不編造；(3) 依 L8，這是供應商自報的產品組合，可確立「Marvell 供應這些產品」，不足以確立競爭地位。

claims.disproof_condition: 取得 Marvell 或其客戶明確具名 1.6T DSP 產品的一手文件，即可建立該邊並使本註記失效。
claims.statement: ⚠ 本輪原目標是補 tech:dsp_1p6t（1.6T DSP）的供給側，**經逐字核對後判定 Marvell FY2026 10-K 不足以支持該邊**，故未建立。理由：全文 DSP 出現 9 次，明確者為 PAM DSPs、coherent／coherent-lite optical DSPs 與 AEC DSPs；`1.6T` 全文僅出現一次，且該句為「Our Ethernet physical-layer transceiver portfolio addresses all the critical speeds ranging from 10Mbps to 1.6Tbps」——講的是 Ethernet PHY 支援速率上限，不是 1.6T DSP 產品。依 L6 Gap 4（具體型號必須在 quote 內逐字出現），不得由「有 optical DSP」＋「有 1.6Tbps PHY」推論出「供應 1.6T DSP」。tech:dsp_1p6t 仍為 0 供應商，需另尋具名 1.6T DSP 的一手來源。

source_doc.permission_basis: U.S. SEC EDGAR filing, public domain government record.
source_doc.title: Marvell Technology FY2026 Form 10-K — Item 1 Business, Interconnects product portfolio

sources.quote: Our interconnect products include PAM (pulse amplitude modulation), coherent and coherent-lite DSPs (digital signal processors), laser drivers, TIAs (trans-impedance amplifiers), silicon photonics, CPO (co-packaged optics), LPO (linear pluggable optics) chipsets, DCI (data center interconnect), AEC (active electrical cable) DSPs and PCIe retimer solutions.

Additionally, our LPO chipsets, comprising of optimized TIAs and laser drivers, address next-generation short-reach, compute fabric connectivity requirements inside AI data centers for connections that have a predictable and controlled channel. LPO modules enabled by our chipsets provide higher bandwidth and greater reach than copper cable interconnects, with optimal latency and power consumption.

These custom offerings are built on our proven ASIC platform which leverages a broad suite of differentiated Marvell intellectual property including ultra-high-speed SerDes, ARM compute, security, storage, silicon photonics and advanced packaging, including die to die interconnects, chiplets, co-packaged optics (“CPO”) and custom high-bandwidth memory (“HBM”).
